title: TML LLVM type mapping for key types
content: LLVM type mapping: Maybe[T] → { i1, T } (tag + value, compact), Outcome[T,E] → { i8, max(sizeof(T), sizeof(E)) }, Str → raw C string pointer (*U8, null-terminated), ref T / mut ref T → T*, Bool → i1, Char → i32, Unit → void, Generic Pair[I32] → %struct.Pair__I32 (double-underscore mangling). Closures are fat pointers { func_ptr, env_ptr }. Key: the Maybe[I32] optimization from 16 bytes to 8 bytes was achieved by using { i32, i32 } instead of { i32, [1 x i64] }.
